text:
gonna edit as i listen!

blue blood: the vibes in this song are immaculate, on the same stage as my satisfaction for me. they sound amazing on this track!!

I AM: this is an amazing title track, nuff said.

kitsch: it took me a while to warm up to the chorus when this dropped, but the verses and prechorus are amazing.

lips: this song is pop music to a tea, a simple cute bop. i love the instrumental for this track, and the little guitar thing to transition into the rap verse from rei and gaeul. liz’s parts stand out a lot here.

heroine: this one didn’t make a huge first impression on me i’d say. the lyrics seem like they’d be good from what i understood, but i wasn’t the biggest fan of the ooh nanana part

mine: this one is really pretty, liz and yujin sound great here. the chorus has a really chill and elegant / pretty vibe. really suits the girls.

hypnosis: that opening almost scared me, but considering the title of the song it made sense. wonyoung sounds very alluring and mysterious in this one. the electronic vibes feel kind of love dive-esque but not really. idk how to describe it. LIZ’s PART(s) THO??? liz you’re amazing. also rei’s flow here is kinda fire. way too short though….

not your girl: already heard this one of course, but it’s a very fun lighthearted vibe, again liz sounds amazing!!! super catchy too. this just makes you feel good!!!

next page: liz starting the song… she’s really blowing it out of the water. she sounds so amazing whenever she sings, i just love her so much. she adds so much texture to their music. this song is lovely. it was interesting to have the rap part sort of “muffled”. the “can i make you mine” was really catchy too.

cherish: this one really intrigued me in the highlight medley, and it didn’t disappoint me. i love yujin and liz at the beginning. as a singing duo they don’t disappoint. i love the way wonyoung sounds in the prechorus. the chorus is really cool, i like the back and forth of rap / talk singing to “regular” singing. piano at the end was nice.

shine with me: this also stood out to me in the highlight medley. more amazing vocals. knowing wonyoung wrote this to the fans, makes it all the more special. this song sounds like GLITTER. this album is super great. the vibes are elegant and pretty. it really suits these amazing girls.

IN CONCLUSION: LIZ.
